rationale: The algebra is internally consistent (the absorbed term Δceq+dvc−ib correctly isolates net equity issuance, so adding dvc back to internal funds is a clean reclassification of dividends to the "returned" side, exactly analogous to the cash-flow family's 4.9%→5.8% improvement), but the change amounts to an additive +dvc/at shift in an already-tested gate and therefore risks simply importing a dividend-payer/payout-yield tilt rather than sharpening the funding-regime classification.

ZSCORE(RANK(x)) is a monotone re-scaling of the same full-net surplus gate already tested in FullNetDistributionGatedExpansion, so this is a cosmetic functional-form variant, and the stated motivation — that the sign classifier "becomes degenerate once returns are netted" — is speculation, since the full-net sign classifier was never run and the gross-flow version scored the archive's best ls_talpha (4.19).

A legitimate but highly predictable consolidation — it is SurplusAndSlackGatedExpansion with the gross-flow surplus swapped for the validated full-net surplus — and the leverage-rank subtraction may simply dilute the stronger flow signal rather than add an independent stock dimension, since the full-net surplus already embeds dltis and dltr.

Margin trajectory is a genuinely untested and economically distinct channel (level of turnover ≠ change in gross profitability), and the construction is coherent and two-sided, but Δ(gross profit/assets) is close to the published change-in-gross-profitability anomaly so the composite may load on that standalone effect, and the proposal inconsistently reverts to the inferior gross-flow surplus after arguing the full-net version is better.

This is the most substantive proposal in the batch because share-count growth captures non-cash funding (stock acquisitions, equity compensation) that every prior gate in the family structurally omits, though the reviewer should verify the result is not simply asset growth crossed with the well-known net-share-issuance anomaly rather than a true funding-regime interaction.

Applying the validated slack condition to the high-coverage accounting-funds gate is a reasonable and diagnostically useful pairing against Signal 1, but it is the same mechanical crossing as Signal 3 with partially redundant leverage information (the absorbed term already contains Δ(dltt+dlc) while the slack rank uses lt/at), and its incremental content over the existing family is thin.
